summary: nitro-cjs-requirer beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: The package ships a postinstall script `beacon.cjs` that POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint over plain HTTP (http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc). The beacon fires both on `npm install` via the `scripts.postinstall` lifecycle hook and on `require('nitro-cjs-requirer')` via `index.js`. The package exposes no real functionality: `index.js` exports a `Proxy` whose property getter returns a no-op for every access, so a bundler or build process that imports this name completes silently instead of failing. The combination of hollow surface, no-op Proxy stub, and host-identifier beacon to a bare-IP plain-HTTP destination is consistent with a dependency-confusion or typosquat lure that silently reports successful installs to the operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
